purpose: Asks why an assistant response was not helpful, right after the thumbs-down in `ChatMessage.Feedback`: a small dialog with one required reason (radio buttons) and optional details, then Send feedback. It turns a bare thumbs-down into a signal the team can act on, without a page or a form of the owner's own. The owner opens it, sends the payload it emits and closes it.
useWhen: After a thumbs-down on an AI response, to collect the reason.
Any rating of generated content that needs a short, categorised reason.
avoidWhen: General product feedback with several fields → a page or `Drawer` form.
related: chat-message` — `ChatMessage.Feedback` holds the thumbs that open it.
confirm-dialog` — the same dialog anatomy for a yes/no decision.
bestPractices: Open it only after a thumbs-down; a thumbs-up needs no reason.
Keep the reasons short and mutually exclusive; the last is `Other`, and details stay optional.
Close it from the `submit` handler once the request succeeds; keep it open with `loading` while it is sent.
